bullets.text: Two school students drowned in Puzhal lake near Ambattur, and the office should monitor safety measures around water bodies.
Dengue claimed a young life in Thiruvallur, prompting public demands that the office must address urgently.
The Supreme Court ordered the demolition of 20 houses on waterbody land in Thiruvallur, which the office should watch.
Anbumani Ramadoss urged the Tamil Nadu government to notify the Pallikaranai marshland and release an integrated management plan, which the office should review.
Transgenders protested at the Gummidipoondi SIPCOT industrial estate in Thiruvallur district, and the office should monitor the situation.
Singapore DPM Gan Kim Yong and Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay opened CapitaLand's first Chennai data centre, highlighting economic ties, and the office should note this.
Equinix India plans to expand its data centre capacity from 20 MW to 70 MW driven by AI, which the portfolio team should track.
Anthropic is in talks for a second Nscale deal worth $45 billion to expand AI computing capacity, and the office should watch these developments.
